author: The Desk
title: Week 2: The Blowout Record Survives By 0.48
body:
Los Muertos put 195.80 on the board, the best score anyone has managed since 2023 and the fifth-highest in league history. The Uncletaker answered with 84.00. The 111.80-point margin is the second-largest ever recorded here, and it misses the record Shadynasty set seven days ago by 0.48. Two weeks into the season, the two biggest beatings in five years of this league are both from this month.

Brendawg21 over druppert, 90.90-85.82, was the closest game and the lowest-scoring one. The only other single-digit margin was Kenzos over Rum Hammers, 130.08-121.42. IR Specialist beat Jimmy Marino 165.48-111.64 and Shadynasty beat Thunder Gun Express 151.86-94.26, neither of which was in doubt for long.

Four teams are 2-0 and hold the top four seeds in points order: Los Muertos, IR Specialist, Shadynasty, Kenzos. The sixth and final playoff spot now belongs to Brendawg21, which climbed from tenth to sixth on a five-point win while sitting dead last in points for at 144.32 — a hundred points behind three of the teams beneath it. Rum Hammers, 37-19 all time and the winningest franchise never to win anything, are 0-2.

Thunder Gun Express is ninth at 0-2, with 239.78 points for, which is ninety-five more than the team currently holding the last playoff spot. Week 3 is druppert, the league's other 0-2 team and the only one scoring less.

author: The Desk
title: Week 1: The Record Book Takes Two Hits In One Game
body:
Los Muertos put up the week's best number, 166.96, and spent it on druppert, who managed 110.46. Shadynasty finished second at 165.70. That game is the one that will get talked about.

Shadynasty 165.70, Brendawg21 53.42. The 112.28-point margin is the largest in league history, past IR Specialist's 108.62 over Jimmy Marino in Week 5 of 2023. Brendawg21's 53.42 is now the lowest single-week score ever recorded here, taking the mark off Thunder Gun Express, whose 60.30 in Week 13 of last season had held it for nine months. Two all-time records, one matchup, opening week.

The only game inside ten points was The Uncletaker over Jimmy Marino, 141.76-133.46. The five winners hold the first five seeds on points; the sixth and final playoff spot goes to the best of the 0-1 teams, which is where the points-for tiebreaker starts earning its keep.

That sixth seed is Thunder Gun Express at 145.52, a number that beat five of the other nine teams and not the one it was actually matched against. Jimmy Marino and Rum Hammers are next in line at 133.46 and 127.74, twelve and eighteen points of scoring back of it. Brendawg21 is tenth and would like Week 2 to arrive promptly.

author: The Desk
title: Four Champions, Four Different Doors
body:
Five seasons in, this league has handed out four trophies to four different teams, and only one of them was the team everybody saw coming.

druppert took the first one in 2022 out of the four seed at 8-6. Kenzos won it in 2023 at 7-7 — the six seed, the last team in, the worst record ever to lift it here. Los Muertos did it from fourth in 2024. Not until last year did the best regular-season team actually finish the job, when Shadynasty went 11-3 and closed it out.

The cruelty is on the other side of that ledger. Shadynasty's 2023 team went 12-2 and scored 2,186.58 points, still the league record by 163, and won nothing; the following year it went 4-10. Rum Hammers are 37-19 all time, second-most wins in the league, four playoff trips, zero rings. Brendawg21 have played four seasons and have yet to see a bracket. Thunder Gun Express sit at exactly 28-28, which is either balance or purgatory.

So: ten teams, fourteen weeks, six spots, and four years of evidence that the table means less here than it should. Week 1 kicks off with everybody at 0-0 and the record book wide open.
